restrictions: Current amendment at the start of proof.md (proof:1-141) governs the candidate: the descriptor layout of 1e179f43, two copies of the opened-cluster code, steps 2 and 3 charged at their emitted instruction counts with refunds of early prelude exits (H5_exec measured), the packed descriptor table, four recalibrated premise margins (H1' factor 98/100, run length 0.49436 with rho_c <= 2^-12, H_G_cluster mean 7,164), and, new, layer H: in a plain context an opened non-straddling cluster whose representative has HE3[(omega >> 17) mod 2^11] = 0 is skipped, losslessly by Lemmas HX and HD; every opened cluster is charged 10 units, a live one 88 more plus 8 per partner lane walked, under the measured premise H_LZ (replacing H_PL). Inherited numbers that depend on these constants are historical. Success assumptions remain heuristic; no full attack success or measured runtime claim is made.

The two messages have 1024t + 55 and 1024t + 63 bytes for one t with 1 <= t < 2^32: t zero chunks of 1024 bytes followed by a last chunk of one block. The last chunk is compressed as a non-root chunk with counter t (v12 = t, v13 = 0), flags 3 and its true block length; the 63-byte block ends in eight zero bytes, so words 14 and 15 and the top byte of word 13 are zero in both zero-filled blocks. Equal last-chunk chaining values give equal digests by the tree lemma of proof.md Section 7.
Unkeyed BLAKE3-256 with 2 prefix rounds, standard IV, permutation and feed-forward, full 256-bit digest; an ordinary collision between two distinct complete messages.

Exact part: for every trial of proof.md Section 8 the two last-chunk chaining values agree on words 0, 2, 5 and 7, E1.c1 lies in the cube of beta* = 18b0e098 so that beta = beta* in every trial, Y4 ranges over the whole class of eta (524,288 values; no sub-class, no rule on h1), and the counter t is solved per trial as ROL(K0.d1,16) XOR K0.a1; trials with t = 0 are skipped. The search continues only in outer steps that pass the exact filter of proof.md Section 8 for the six listed E1 outcomes S = {175,185,275,285,385,685}020a0 (share 279,070,422,111 / 2^48 = 2^-9.9782); of these, the joint solver sees only those kept by the exact s-pattern pre-check, and its guards (G7) and (G15) drop only words that hold no success, so by Lemmas F, VP, G7 and G15 none of these steps loses a counted success. The eight other outcomes of beta* are not counted as successes.

Heuristic part: under H1', H4', H5_exec, H_G_cluster and H_LZ, each stated for the advice record of proof.md Section 12, with probability at least 0.39 the search finds a trial whose remaining 128 chaining-value bits also agree. It walks 2^90.0016 trials: 2^50.0016 contexts (proof.md 9.8), each the seven outer words of one fresh draw, times the 2^19 members of the class, times the 2^21 trials of an outer step.

Machine: a classical word RAM with 256-bit words under collision-frontier-v5, 430 machine units (operations, loads, stores) to the unit, 64 registers and constants as immediates; fetching a word from memory is a load. Charges (proof.md 9.8, 11, amendments A, C, D and H): 57,226 units per context; 52 per batch of seven representatives (40 for the last; 2,341 per context); 72 per old partner batch of seven packed 36-bit lanes (a chunk: 16 plus 8 per lane) (8 per lane test on R2 and L2 after a shift to lane 0, 7 in lane 0); 56 per fill (the batch's cached Y9); 10 per E lane (R1 and L1, Lemma T26); 43 per passing lane and 6 more per call; 10 per opened cluster, 88 more per live one and 8 per partner lane walked (amendment H), and 364 more per straddling one.

Cluster gate and masked walk (proof.md 9.9, Lemmas CL, XF, OR): the 32 members that differ only in bits 10 to 14 of e1 form a cluster; a gate value computed with no table skips the cluster when its omega misses S7 and it does not straddle; an opened non-straddling cluster walks only the partners of its descriptor's two chunks, a straddling one the five old partner batches. Neither loses anything. No premise: Lemma OR bounds the opened clusters by 0.40633153915... of a context's and the straddling ones by 9/4 on average; A_BUDGET and FB_BUDGET are passed with probability at most exp(-20) each. In a plain context (amendment H) an opened non-straddling cluster whose representative has HE3[(omega >> 17) mod 2^11] = 0 is dead and is skipped: by Lemmas HX and HD no member passes test (2).

Building R1 and L1 (101,376 words, one copy, Lemma DT) costs below 2^25 units once; R2, L2 and the class maps 2^27 (no PXR). When the pre-check keeps outcomes T, the solver with the guards (G7) and (G15), charged at the instruction counts of its emitted code (global 184, 1,089 a row, 16 a forced node, 11 more at position 15, 17 a free node, 35 a leaf, 88 a root), starts only if the credit left covers its cap CM(T) <= 7,115 (Lemma FX), and a meter debits each executed block's unit cost, so the debit equals the executed ledger U (Lemma ME). The credit is 136,712,143,855,319,043,944 machine units. These are proved upper allowances of a specified layout, not measured counts; nothing is sorted and every word-indexed read is charged as a load.

Halts: opened, live and straddling clusters, partner lanes, test-(2) lanes, fills, passing lanes and calls add their units to one work register W; a context starts only if W <= WB = 1,730,432,127,777,021,894,695, the seven units times their budgets, and one context adds at most W_CTX = 38,483,480; the run also stops when a metered cap CM(T) is larger than the credit left, and after RUN_CONTEXTS = 1,127,113,088,900,472 contexts. The time bound charges WB + W_CTX for the six counted events, RUN_CONTEXTS + 1 contexts, all 2,341 * RUN_CONTEXTS representative batches and the whole credit, so it holds for every run (proof.md Sections 9, 11).

Provenance: the counter search of entry 415e792c and its successors, with the contributions credited in proof.md Sections 15 and 16 (hecmas, Th0rgal, 0xshikhar, winglock, 5kyguy, tekkac, Jbenisek and helper agents, GPT Sol, GPT-6 Astra, GPT Luna 5.6, Grok), the descriptor layout of 1e179f43 the layers B to G of 785acf86, 034414ab, 41128eca and 0ea30357, and layer H of this package. Randomness: one fresh uniform 256-bit word per context. Each context visits each member once or skips it where it fails test (2) (Lemmas CX, CL, XF), so means over outer steps are those of a uniform outer step; independence holds between contexts only. Success 0.39 holds only under H1', H4', H5_exec, H_G_cluster and H_LZ.

The factor 135,742,441,390 in H1' is 98/100 of the model's conditional count of the six listed outcomes on the class, rounded down, and is not measured by the organizer-run experiment, which executes the search on one context per trial and returns root-instance pairs (counter 0, flags 11): no digest experiment can show a half-collision of a non-root chunk's chaining value. The cluster gate, the filter, the pre-check, (G7) and (G15) lose nothing; the two count shares matter only for the budgets (H4'), the mean fills only for the fill budget (H_G_cluster) the mean executed ledger only for the credit (H5_exec), and the mean units of live clusters and partner lanes only for Z_BUDGET (H_LZ); the high-part test of layer H loses nothing (Lemma HD). No full 2-round collision is exhibited.

The declared program experiments/frontline.py executes the search of proof.md 9.1 on one context per organizer trial, 32 clusters each, with the units of proof.md Section 11 added per event, the work register, credit and halts, and in the same run checks every walked member, every member of a dead cluster, left-out partner, cached Y9, passing lane and metered debit against straight-line or scalar recomputations (proof.md 9.2; experiments/manifest.json). Its observations are its own counts. No root of the search occurs at that scale.

Fixed nonuniform advice, stated in full in proof.md Section 12: X3 = bf1c5f38, X7 = c0e3a0c8, X11 = c4036000, X15 = c0c5fb02, W4 = 7ffffffa and W13 = 00074004; eta = 830303cf; beta* = 18b0e098 with cube mask 0e09818b and value 0c008000; the seven tau values, eps = 6e21be55 and S = 5f, 73 bytes (nonuniform_advice_log2_bytes 7). The record is an input to the attack, not the output of a claimed selection algorithm. The success analysis uses only exact properties of this record verified in proof.md; H1', H4', H5_exec, H_G_cluster and H_LZ are stated for this record.

preprocessing_log2 54, included in time_log2, conservatively charges all historical work that constructed the 73-byte advice: S_old = 5,486,510,246,044,225,536 machine units, below 2^53.503 target-compression units, covering the 116 predecessor searches, model processing, exact counters and the three-attempt replay. It is accounting for completed construction work, not a premise that a capped selector returns the record. The deterministic table and code setup, 1,125,918,441,472,040 machine units, is in the search rows. The complete numerator is 2,074,324,404,800,749,025,353 machine units, giving time_log2 62.0649387 (claimed 62.06494). Historical construction peaks at 37,928,960 bytes; the search phase is below 34,246,336 and the streamed output phase below 136,256 bytes, so memory_log2_bytes is 25.17680. No priority or novelty claim is made.

heuristics.statement: Score-critical. Stated for the instance that the advice record of proof.md Section 12 fixes, and for no other. The run has RUN_CONTEXTS independent contexts, each the seven outer words of one fresh uniform 256-bit word, and every context visits all 2^19 members of the class, except the members of clusters that the gate of proof.md 9.9 skips, which fail test (2) and hold no listed good trial (Lemmas CX and CL). Let N_o be the number of listed good valid trials of one outer step (t != 0, R = 0, and an E1 outcome in S = {175,185,275,285,385,685}020a0, six outcomes of beta*; Y4 in the whole class of eta; no rule on h1), counted over all of Q* whether or not the outer step passes the filter or the pre-check, and N_c its sum over the 2^19 outer steps of a context. (i) For a uniform outer step U (seven uniform outer words, a uniform member), E[N_o(U)] >= (2^21 - 1) q with q = FACTOR * 2^-128, FACTOR = floor(98 * 138,512,695,296 / 100) = 135,742,441,390, so q is about 2^-91.018 (just under 98/100 of the conditional model rate p of Lemma S1 for S); by Lemma CX (c), E[N_c] = 2^19 E[N_o(U)], so (i) is the statement of entry 415e792c. (ii) With the context as the unit, as entry e9b6649e declares it: the probability that no valid trial of the run is a listed good trial is at most exp(-0.49436) + 0.000038 = 0.6099992; that is, listed good trials are not clustered, neither among the trials of one outer step nor among the outer steps (members) of one context, beyond what this bound allows. Given (i), rho_c = E[N_c(N_c-1)]/E[N_c] <= 2^-12 is sufficient for (ii) by Lemma S8 applied to the independent contexts (exponent at least 0.49436 (1 - 2^-13), proof.md amendment B2). rho_c = rho_w + rho_x, where rho_w is the per-step factorial ratio of entry 415e792c and rho_x >= 0 the part that pairs of different members of one context add, so this clause is stronger than the per-step clause of entry 415e792c. Part (ii) is an assumption: rho_c is not measured and cannot be measured at full size (proof.md 10.3). This restates the rate-and-dependence premise of entry 26ebba63 for the whole class, S and the walk by contexts; that entry's clause was for the sub-class of 2^17 members with rule A and seven outcomes and does not by itself imply this law (GPT Sol, answer AT 2). It is declared here anew. By Lemma F every listed good trial lies in an outer step that passes the filter, by Lemma CL the cluster gate skips none, by Lemma VP the pre-check skips none and by Lemmas G7 and G15 the guards (G7) and (G15) drop none, so N_o is the same count, pointwise (GPT Sol, answer AW 1).
heuristics.scope: Exactly the trials of proof.md Sections 8 and 9: lengths 1024t + 55 and 1024t + 63 with a non-root last chunk (counter t, v13 = 0, flags 3), the six constants of Section 3.2, Y4 ranging over all 524,288 members of the class of eta (Lemma Q) inside every context, a context being the seven outer words of one fresh 256-bit word of the run (proof.md 9.8, Lemma CX); in every trial E1.c1 is drawn from the cube of beta* = 18b0e098, and t is solved per trial, with t = 0 skipped. The search continues only in outer steps that pass the exact filter of Section 8 for S, the solver sees only those that the pre-check of 9.7 keeps, and it applies the guards (G7) and (G15); N_o counts all of Q* in every outer step and only the six outcomes of S.
heuristics.extrapolation: From the participant's exact count, in integer arithmetic under the seven-word model of Section 10 with Y4 uniform in the class, of the part of beta* on the class carried by the six outcomes of S (67,633,152 = 1,032 * 2^16 on the per-trial scale 2^-83 of the class; the counting program and the six rows of its output are printed in Section 17), times 2^11 for drawing E1.c1 from the cube (Lemma S1), taken at 98/100, rounded down (proof.md amendment B1). The filter, the pre-check, (G7) and (G15) change neither the count nor the premise (Lemmas S9 (b), VP, G7 and G15). Participant evidence of Section 13, untrusted by the harness: a whole-class graphics-card run of 2^46 real counter trials in 2^25 passing outer steps, with a sub-class control of the same size, in which every measured quantity matches the exact model within 1.5 clustered standard errors, among them the E1 rate on the whole class of the seven outcomes of entry 59f8915e, 1.0020 +- 0.0086 of the model (13,595 events), and its ratio to the sub-class rate, 0.9895 +- 0.0120 (model 1); the E1 event of S is a sub-event of that measured event (52/53 of it in the model); and a reduced-width (8-bit) end-to-end run of complete messages, with no sub-class and no rule, in which the counter arrangement found 251 collisions against 255.0 predicted, and, in a preregistered rerun, 40,882 against 40,800.63 (1.00199 +- 0.00496; one-sided 97.7 per cent lower bound 0.99213, above 98/100 by the rule fixed in advance (a margin m is supported when that bound is at least 1/m); 0.97256 at 1-1e-9, which is below 98/100). The two-sigma lower bounds of the 32-bit whole-class E1 measurements, about 0.985, are also above 98/100. At 32 bits the joint 128-bit event itself, about 2^-91 per trial, is not measured. Dependence (proof.md 10.3 and Section 13, participant runs on the counter instance made after the design): part (ii) is assumed, not measured. Under the model E[N_c] is about 2^-51.018, and rho_x is about v * E[N_c], where v is the clustering ratio of listed good trials by context (1 for independent members); so (ii) fails only if v exceeds about 2^39, or if one listed good trial makes another in the same context far more likely than its rate. Evidence that v is near 1: the same ratio, (E[n(n-1)]/E[n]) / ((2^19 - 1) p_hat) for per-context counts of events that every listed good trial meets, is 1.1513 for the filter pass, 1.1572 for the pass with the pre-check and 1.153 for an outer step whose solver reaches a leaf (120,000 contexts; control arms of independent outer steps 1.0000, 1.0000 and 0.998), and 1.2486 +- 0.0806 for an outer step whose solver returns a root (46,104,576 contexts; control 1.0367 +- 0.0718); it does not grow with depth beyond the errors. The clustering comes from condition (2), whose omega has w8 fixed by the context. Preregistered (proof.md Section 13; 262,144 contexts and 2^46 trials per arm, two generators, a control arm): the cross-member factor Rx is 0.999 +- 0.054 (upper limit 1.162) for the listed E1 outcome, 2^-32.29 per trial, 0.90 +- 0.24 (upper limit 1.94) for (J1) and (J2) of the E3 half, 2^-34.58, and 1.0002 for R24, 2^-23.76; only the filter events cluster (1.144, 1.152); every upper limit lies at least 38 bits below the 2^39 that the clause allows.
heuristics.limitations: The factor 135,742,441,390 is assumed (98/100 of the model count of the six outcomes of S on the class, rounded down). The premise of entry 26ebba63 was for the sub-class with rule A; it is not inherited, and the whole-class law of N_o for S is declared, not proved. The organizer-run experiment executes the search on one context per trial and returns root-instance pairs (counter 0, flags 11); it measures neither the factor nor the counter half-collision, which no digest experiment can show. Part of the transfer of the single-trial law to the actual sampler is proved (Lemmas S1-S5, S8, S9, VP, G7 and G15) and part is assumed in (i). Part (ii) is an assumption: the bound rho_c <= 2^-12 is not measured and cannot be measured at full size, since a context holds a listed good trial with probability about 2^-51.018; the proved cap of 16 listed good trials in one outer step (Lemmas CV, G7 and G15) does not help at this run length. Stated for contexts, it is stronger than a per-step clause, since it adds the cross-member part rho_x. The clustering ratios that support it are measured for events that every listed good trial meets, from the filter to the roots of the solver (one generator, after the design) and, preregistered with two generators, the two halves of a listed good trial, not for listed good trials: the joint event, about 2^-91 per trial, is not reachable, so carrying Rx near 1 to it remains the premise. The whole-class graphics-card run measures the E1 side of the seven outcomes together and the filter, not the six of S on their own, not the E3 side nor the joint event. Lemmas F, VP, G7, G15 and S9 (a) use no law of the words; the 8-bit end-to-end run has no filter. The 8-bit runs are evidence under the model's uniform free words, not at 32 bits. The factor 98/100 rests on two-sigma evidence: at 1 - 10^-9 the 8-bit lower bound is 0.97256 and the older 32-bit sub-class E1 measurement has a two-sigma lower bound of 0.9756, both below 98/100.

heuristics.statement: Supporting; stated for the advice record of proof.md Section 12. For an outer step of the run let I_E be 1 when its test-(2) mask meets S and I_2 be 1 when it passes the filter for S. Premise: for a uniform outer step U, and hence for the mean over the outer steps of one context (Lemma CX (c)), Pr(I_E(U) = 1) <= 1.000026 * 233,715,456 / 2^32 and Pr(I_2(U) = 1) <= 1.000176 * 279,070,422,111 / 2^48, the exact shares of Section 8 (2^-4.1998 and 2^-9.9782) times the declared factors. Use, proved given the premise: each budget is its premise mean over the RUN_STEPS = 590,931,867,153,450,663,936 outer steps, rounded up, plus 2^19 s with s = ceil(sqrt(10 RUN_CONTEXTS)): E_BUDGET = 32,157,111,148,820,462,936 E lanes and PASS_BUDGET = 586,042,493,902,474,223 passing outer steps. Both counts add up independent per-context counts between 0 and 2^19 (Lemma CX), so Hoeffding's inequality over the contexts bounds each overflow by exp(-2 s^2 / RUN_CONTEXTS) <= exp(-20); with the credit, fill, call, opened-cluster and straddling-cluster tails, partner-lane, all eight lie within the allowance 2 * 10^-8. A count above its budget can make the work register W pass WB and halt the run with failure; the time bound charges WB + W_CTX. The number of outer steps that reach the solver has no budget: the solver is paid from the credit of H5exec-executed-solver-work (GPT Sol, answer AW 5).
heuristics.scope: The counts N_E and N_2 of proof.md 10.3, taken over all RUN_STEPS outer steps, every member of every context (9.1, 9.8): per context, each count lies between 0 and 2^19, the contexts are independent, and the mean per context is 2^19 times the indicator's probability for a uniform outer step (Lemma CX (c)); the two indicators of one outer step may depend on each other in any way.
heuristics.extrapolation: The nominal shares are exact for uniform independent (Y9, omega) (GPT Sol, answers AC, AN and AW 3; the certificate of Section 8). The factors are the least on a grid of one part per million that pass a lower-tail Chernoff test at exp(-7), (m - k)^2 >= 14 m with m = 2^39 * factor * share, on the counts of our preregistered sample of 2^39 real outer steps of the whole class (proof.md 10.3 and Section 13): 29,915,698,553 test-(2) lanes against 29,915,578,368 and 545,067,537 passing steps against 545,059,418.18 (GPT Sol, answer CK 2.1); in exact rational arithmetic each factor passes and the one a part per million lower fails. Other measurements (Section 13, untrusted by the harness, whole class): on 60,000,000 real outer steps the two counts are 1.0004 +- 0.0005 (test (2)) and 0.9980 +- 0.0041 (pass) of their nominal values; with the member loop, 120,000 contexts with all 2^19 members each: pass share 0.99847 and test-(2) share 0.99868 of nominal. The declared experiment reports its E lanes and passes per trial (proof.md 9.2: 0.0546 of cluster members over 4,096 trials in the participant's run).
heuristics.limitations: The bounds on the indicators' probabilities are not proved: Y9 and omega are not proved independent and uniform. The factors rest on one preregistered sample from one pseudorandom generator (Philox4x32-10) under an independent-draw reading of the Chernoff test, which is an evidence limitation, not a proof of the physical means. The time bound, the filter and the pre-check do not depend on these shares; if a count passes its budget the work register can halt the run with failure, which lowers the success probability only.

heuristics.statement: Supporting; stated for the advice record of proof.md Section 12, with the ledger of amendments E and F (proof.md lines 1-141). For an outer step of the run, before any halt, let U be the debit of its call of steps 2 and 3 by the emitted meter: A(T) = 184 + 1,089 r for the r rows of the outcomes T that its pre-check keeps, less the refund of every row prelude that leaves at an early exit (that row is then debited the longest path to its exit plus 2, 68 to 578), plus the charge of every executed block of the tree (16 per forced node, 11 more at position 15, 17 per free node, 35 per leaf, 88 per root); U = 0 when T is empty. Every call executes at most its debit (amendments E, F). Premise (measured): for a uniform outer step, and hence for the mean over the outer steps of one context (Lemma CX (c)), E[U] <= u_U = 65,117,111,395,830 / 2^48 = 0.2313425. Use, proved given the premise: U <= CM(T) <= 7,115 in every call (Lemma ME with the charges of E); CREDIT = m_C + ceil(sqrt(40 L_C m_C)) + 14 L_C + 7,115 = 136,712,143,855,319,043,944 with m_C = ceil(RUN_STEPS u_U) = 136,707,627,336,736,912,199 and L_C = 7,115 * 2^19; Bernstein's inequality over the independent contexts puts an overflow below exp(-20). Every call has U >= 184 + 68 = 252 (Lemma CP), so CALL_BUDGET = ceil(m_C / 252) + 2^19 s = 542,546,246,010,770,826, exceeded with probability below exp(-20). The time bound charges the whole credit whether or not the premise holds.
heuristics.scope: U for every one of the RUN_STEPS outer steps of proof.md 9.1, that is, for every member of every one of the RUN_CONTEXTS contexts (9.8), as a function of the context's outer words and the member, with S = 0x5f, the masks X of the filter of Section 8, nu by formula (V) of 9.7, the solver of 9.4 with (G7) and (G15) and the unit costs of Section 11 with the charges of amendment E (global 184, 1,089 per searched row, the node charges of the emitted code); the mean is over all outer steps, passing or not, with the zeros counted.
heuristics.extrapolation: Measured (participant, untrusted; protocol fixed before the run, SHA-256 dba4dc7256796297e20bb248b0c7b5e38ac5c149ea0486dfaa3deb691b94f070): 2^30 i.i.d. uniform outer steps from SHAKE256 words, each call run on the participant's interpreter of the emitted code with the refund post-pass, checked against frontline.py's solver (same roots in the same order; executed + 53 <= refunded debit <= debit of E; 0 failures in 265,740 calls). Calls per outer step 0.00024749 (0.99849 of the model p_call), rows per call 1.27116 (model 1.27163); mean refunded ledger 0.2290168 per outer step with standard error 0.0004896; declared value mean + 4.75 SE = 0.2313425. The same sample gives 0.3947528 (SE 0.0008061) for the ledger of E, 0.9734 of its model value 0.405551. Historical (proof.md Section 13): the preregistered call frequency 0.99604 of the model.
heuristics.limitations: Not proved: the mean of the refunded ledger for the sampler; the value is a one-sided normal-theory bound from one sample of one generator, i.i.d. outer steps rather than the walk by contexts (equal means by Lemma CX (c)). The interpreter and the sampler are the participant's and are not in the package. If the premise fails, the credit can halt the run with failure, which lowers the success probability and not the time bound.

heuristics.statement: Supporting; stated for the advice record of proof.md Section 12. This is the premise H_G_cluster of GPT Sol's answer CM 5, restated for the fills that the masked walk executes. A fill is the 56 units of proof.md Section 11 that a group of lanes pays once, at its first lane whose test (2) is positive (T2(omega) != 0). For a context C of the run let F(C) be the number of fills of the masked walk of proof.md 9.8 and 9.9 in C, counted without halts: one fill for each representative batch that holds an opened representative with a positive test (2); for each opened cluster that straddles (gate entry above 1), one fill for each of the five old partner batches (members 1 to 7, 8 to 14, 15 to 21, 22 to 28, 29 to 31) that holds a member with a positive test (2); for each opened cluster that does not straddle, one fill for each of the two chunks of its descriptor that holds a member with a positive test (2); none for a closed cluster. F(C) is a function of the seven outer words alone, and F(C) <= G(C) <= 84,261 (Lemma XF (d)), G(C) being the number of the context's 84,261 batches (representative batches and five partner batches of every cluster) that hold a member with a positive test (2). Premise: for a context with uniform outer words, E[F(C)] <= 7,164. Use, proved given the premise (GPT Sol, answer CM 5): the fill budget is G_BUDGET = 7,164 RUN_CONTEXTS + 84,261 s = 8,074,647,114,501,170,571 with s = ceil(sqrt(10 RUN_CONTEXTS)); the F(C) of the contexts are independent and lie between 0 and 84,261, so Hoeffding's inequality over the contexts bounds the overflow by exp(-2 s^2 / RUN_CONTEXTS) <= exp(-20); a halt only stops fills. No law of the batches, lanes or members inside a context is used. Fills above the budget can make the work register W pass WB and halt the run with failure; the time bound charges WB + W_CTX.
heuristics.scope: F(C) for every one of the RUN_CONTEXTS contexts of proof.md 9.1, with the cluster map, the gate, the descriptor chunks, the old partner batches of straddling clusters and the direct table T2 restricted to S of the declared program (proof.md 9.8, 9.9: clusters of 32 members that differ in bits 10 to 14 of e1, representative batches of seven); the mean is over contexts with uniform outer words.
heuristics.extrapolation: Measured, untrusted by the harness (proof.md Section 13), on a preregistered sample: the quantity F(C), the program, the seeds and the sample size 2^24 were written in a protocol and sealed before any context of the sample existed. Sample of 2^24 = 16,777,216 contexts with SHAKE256 outer words, F counted exactly as the declared walk counts its fills by a graphics-card program described in proof.md Section 13 with the SHA-256 of its source. The program agreed with a Python mirror built from the declared program's own functions in all eight record fields in 2,048 of 2,048 contexts, and the declared walk itself agreed with the mirror in fills, E lanes and opened clusters in 13 of 13 contexts. Result: sum 120,112,551,275, sum of squares 979,397,328,433,193, mean 7,159.266, unbiased variance 7,121,541.31, standard error 0.6515, largest 14,404; F exceeded the five-partner count G' in no context. Declared value (proof.md amendment B4): the empirical Bernstein bound of Maurer and Pontil (2009, Theorem 4) for i.i.d. variables in [0, 84,261] at confidence 1 - 10^-9, mean + sqrt(2 V ln(2/delta) / n) + 7 * 84,261 ln(2/delta) / (3 (n - 1)) = 7,159.266 + 4.264 + 0.251 = 7,163.78, that is 7,164; the earlier range-only Hoeffding bound at 1 - exp(-7) was 7,197.75. No normal approximation is used.
heuristics.limitations: Not proved: the mean of F for uniform outer words. The empirical Bernstein bound holds for any i.i.d. law of F on [0, 84,261] and is computed from one i.i.d. sample of one pseudorandom generator (SHAKE256 words in place of uniform words); it is evidence about the mean of the declared walk, not a proof. The measurement concerns the mean of F of the declared walk only; it does not test H1', H4' or H5_exec. If the premise fails, fills above the budget can halt the run with failure, which lowers the success probability and not the time bound.

heuristics.statement: Supporting; stated for the advice record of proof.md Section 12 and amendment H, replacing H_PL of amendment D. For a context C of the run let Z(C) be the sum, over the opened clusters of C that do not straddle (gate value 1) and are not dead (amendment H: those with HE3[(omega >> 17) AND HM] = 1 at the representative's omega, HM = 2^11 - 1 in a plain context and 0 otherwise, HE3[0] = 1), of 88 plus 8 times the partner lanes the cluster walks in its descriptor's chunks, counted without halts; 0 <= Z(C) <= 16,384 * 160. Premise: for a context with uniform outer words, E[Z(C)] <= 756,150. Use, proved given the premise: these units have the budget Z_BUDGET = 756,150 RUN_CONTEXTS + 2,621,440 s = 852,266,840,478,797,802,320 in WB; the Z(C) of the contexts are independent and lie in [0, 2,621,440], so Hoeffding's inequality bounds the overflow by exp(-2 s^2 / RUN_CONTEXTS) <= exp(-20), the eighth tail of proof.md 10.4 inside the allowance 2 * 10^-8; an overflow can only halt the run with failure, and the time bound charges WB + W_CTX.
heuristics.scope: Z(C) for every one of the RUN_CONTEXTS contexts, with the gate, the plain rule, the table HE3, the descriptor chunks and the survivors of Lemma XF of the declared program; every opened cluster is charged U_HEAD = 10 within A_BUDGET (Lemma OR, no premise) and a straddling one 364 more (FB_BUDGET).
heuristics.extrapolation: Exact part: in a live non-straddling cluster the partners walked are exactly popcount(LW[b8]) - alive16 of the representative (Lemma XF (a), (c)), and deadness is a function of the context and the representative's omega (Lemmas HX and HD). Measured (participant, untrusted; protocol fixed before the run, SHA-256 810608de748afccdaa782bc49d0e0ed6ad2e21d615bc741f08658747279a1fc4 (v2)): 2^27 i.i.d. (context, cluster) samples from SHAKE256 words; X = 88 + 8 lanes for a live gate-1 cluster, else 0. Sum 6,189,015,656, sum of squares 953,436,345,152, mean 46.1117600, unbiased variance 4,977.360; the empirical Bernstein bound (Maurer and Pontil 2009, Theorem 4) for X in [0, 160] at delta = 10^-9 is 46.1516745, and 2^14 times it, rounded up, is 756,150 (4,909.8 live and 1,745.1 dead clusters and 40,428.9 lanes per context). The sampler gave the same X as the declared program's own gate entry, plain rule and HE3 on 200,000 of 200,000 samples of the v2 run, and with the test disabled it reproduces amendment D's lane mean (3.344906 against 3.3451954).
heuristics.limitations: Not proved: the mean of Z(C) for uniform outer words; the sample uses SHAKE256 words in place of uniform words and one cluster per sampled context, and the sampler is participant code outside the package. If the premise fails, live clusters and partner lanes above the budget can halt the run with failure, which lowers the success probability and not the time bound.
